display.purpose: Page h1 in uppercase Michroma; home hero uses clamp(1.75rem, 3.8vw, 3.5rem).

lede.purpose: One intro paragraph under a heading.

label.purpose: Uppercase Muted field labels, captions and the Sample render label.

motion.name: lights-on
motion.purpose: Hero tower crossfades dusk to lit. Static under reduced motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: from opacity 0.2, translateY(28px); animation-timeline: view(), entry 0-40%

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled Action Blue pill; one per view for the main action.
components.html: Book a growth call
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6em; padding:.95em 1.5em; border-radius:999px; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-weight:600; font-size:.95rem; line-height:1; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); color:#eef1f5; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .03); transition:border-color .3s, background .3s, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-blue { background:#1463e0; border-color:#1463e0; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 12px 28px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / .9); } .ds-btn-blue:hover { background:#0f56c8; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default pill for secondary actions such as Chat on WhatsApp.
components.html: Chat on WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6em; padding:.95em 1.5em; border-radius:999px; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-weight:600; font-size:.95rem; line-height:1; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); color:#eef1f5; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .03); transition:border-color .3s, background .3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#59a8ff; background:rgb(31 123 255 / .12); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Band Form
components.description: Signature pill lead form from the brand graphic, with a blue corner-block submit.
components.css: .ds-band { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .28); border-radius:999px; background:rgb(7 11 22 / .72); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); overflow:hidden; } .ds-band label { display:grid; padding:14px 26px; border-right:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); } .ds-band label:focus-within { background:rgb(31 123 255 / .08); } .ds-band span { font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#9aa3b2; } .ds-band input { font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-weight:500; font-size:1rem; color:#eef1f5; background:transparent; border:0; padding:4px 0 0; outline:none; } .ds-band input::placeholder { color:#838c9d; } .ds-band button { border:0; padding:0 34px 0 30px; background:linear-gradient(115deg,#1463e0 0%,#0d4fc4 100%); color:#fff; font:400 .82rem/1.3 var(--display, Michroma, Eurostile, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:left; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .3s; } .ds-band button:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-band button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:-4px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Boxed field for the full lead form; the border carries focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; padding:14px 18px; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .2); border-radius:12px; background:rgb(4 5 10 / .6); transition:border-color .3s; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color:#59a8ff; } .ds-field span { font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#9aa3b2; } .ds-field input { font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-weight:500; font-size:1rem; color:#eef1f5; background:transparent; border:0; outline:none; padding:4px 0 0; }

components.name: Service Chip
components.description: Pill multi-select for services in the lead form.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:10px; } .ds-chips label { position:relative; } .ds-chips input { position:absolute; opacity:0; } .ds-chips span { display:block; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); border-radius:999px; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:.92rem; color:#c9ced6; cursor:pointer; transition:all .25s; } .ds-chips span:hover { border-color:#59a8ff; } .ds-chips input:checked + span { background:rgb(31 123 255 / .18); border-color:#59a8ff; color:#eef1f5; } .ds-chips input:focus-visible + span { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header links with Arc Blue underline on hover/current, plus the primary pill.
components.html: ServicesWorkAboutBook a growth call
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { text-decoration:none; font-size:.95rem; color:#c9ced6; text-underline-offset:.25em; text-decoration-thickness:1px; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:#eef1f5; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:#59a8ff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { padding:.95em 1.5em; border-radius:999px; background:#1463e0; color:#fff; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta:hover { background:#0f56c8; text-decoration:none; color:#fff; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Ruled list row with line icon, title, muted line and arrow; indents on hover.
components.html: Drone shootsAerial footage that shows the location.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto; gap:8px 22px; align-items:center; padding:28px 0; border-top:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); border-bottom:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); text-decoration:none; color:#c9ced6; transition:background .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), padding .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { padding-left:14px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(31 123 255 / .1), transparent 70%); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-ic { width:34px; height:34px; color:#59a8ff; grid-row:1 / span 2; } .ds-row b { font:400 clamp(1rem,1.5vw,1.2rem)/1.12 var(--display, Michroma, Eurostile, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#eef1f5; } .ds-row span { grid-column:2; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:.98rem; color:#9aa3b2; } .ds-go { grid-row:1 / span 2; grid-column:3; width:22px; color:#59a8ff; transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-row:hover .ds-go { transform:translateX(6px); }

components.name: Media Frame
components.description: 14px clipped image frame with an overlaid Sample caption.
components.css: .ds-frame { position:relative; margin:0; width:320px; aspect-ratio:16/10; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgb(201 206 214 / .14); background:#070b16; } .ds-img { position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a1630,#070b16 60%,#04050a); } .ds-frame figcaption { position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0; padding:40px 18px 14px; font-family: var(--body, "Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#eef1f5; background:linear-gradient(transparent, rgb(4 5 10 / .88)); }

components.name: WhatsApp Float
components.description: Fixed circular WhatsApp button, the only use of WhatsApp Green.
components.css: .ds-wa { width:58px; height:58px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; background:#1fa855; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 12px 30px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / .7); transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-wa:hover { transform:scale(1.06); } .ds-wa:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #59a8ff; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is lit like a property shoot in the twenty minutes after sunset. Every page is a sky that falls from navy at the top to near-black at the ground, with one electric-blue arc, taken from the logo's V swoosh, sweeping behind the headline and carrying the eye from section to section. Silver wide-tracked capitals are the wall lettering on the building. The body copy is a quiet, legible sans.

Density is low and cinematic: tall sections, large renders, and hairline rules in place of boxes. Light in the world comes from three sources only: the sky gradient, the arc, and lit windows in the imagery. The build rejects the category default of a flat black page with neon glow and a grid of icon cards.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-to-black vertical sky on every hero; dark scheme only.
One tapered blue arc per section that uses it, always decorative and behind content.
Silver uppercase Michroma display over Manrope body.
Hairline dividers and list rows instead of cards.
Pill shapes for actions, 14px corners for media.
Scroll-driven motion in CSS only, static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Blue-Hour Sky Rule
rules.body: Each top-of-page hero is a vertical gradient from Sky to Ground (the home hero passes through Night at 55%). Never a flat black hero.

rules.name: The Light Sources Rule
rules.body: Blue light only enters a page through the arc, a blue gradient wash (the close section's radial at 22% alpha, the service-row hover sweep), or lit windows in the imagery. Text and boxes never glow.

rules.name: The Wall Lettering Rule
rules.body: Michroma is always uppercase at weight 400, and its tracking widens as size falls: 0.02em for h1/h2, 0.08em for h3, and 0.32em for the wordmark and the "Build · Grow · Scale" motto. Never set it in sentence case or bold.

dos: Do start every hero with the Sky to Ground gradient and at most one arc behind the headline.
Do use Arc Blue for interactive accents and Action Blue only for filled primary actions with white text.
Do set headings in uppercase Michroma 400 with the tracking ladder from the Wall Lettering Rule.
Do group content as ruled rows with 1px Line dividers.
Do label every demonstration render "Sample" and embed provenance in every shipped raster.
Do keep motion in CSS scroll timelines with a static fallback.
donts: Don't add glowing box-shadows or neon text glow. Blue light comes only from the arc, gradient washes, and lit windows.
Don't lay out services or features as a grid of icon cards.
Don't use WhatsApp Green anywhere except the floating WhatsApp button.
Don't add light themes or light surfaces. The scheme is dark only.
Don't use filled or multi-weight icons, icon fonts, or emoji. Use the 1.5px line family only.
